A '''local year''' or '''revolution''' was the term given to the [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Time/Legends|period]] of an astronomical object. The local year on [[Adari]] was 409 [[Standard day/Legends|standard days]] long.

The [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire's]] [[chronological circuitry]], which could be installed into [[Rakatan guardian droid]]s, could detect how many revolutions had taken place and were used as a dating device. On [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], the [[Overseer (droid)|Overseer]] had served as a Rakatan guardian droid for ten revolutions by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. As [[Bastila Shan]] confronted the droid in [[3956 BBY]], she realized that ten revolutions corresponded to 20,000 years.
